name: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Napa Valley
positioning: Vineyard resort in Calistoga, in California's Napa Valley wine country, with a Michelin-starred restaurant, an on-site winery and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want to stay beside a vineyard in Napa Valley wine country
Guests who want a Michelin-starred restaurant and an on-site winery at their resort
Families, since the resort has a family pool and a Kids Activity Room

facts.text: The resort is at 400 Silverado Trail, Calistoga, California 94515.
Auro offers seven courses of contemporary American cuisine.
TRUSS Restaurant + Bar is a brasserie-style farm-to-table restaurant.
Campo Poolside is an open-air poolside restaurant.
The resort has an on-site winery, Elusa Winery.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
The resort has two outdoor pools, one for families and one for adults.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The resort has 15 cabanas and daybeds around the Adult and Resort pools.
The resort has a Kids Activity Room.
Premium Wi-Fi is a complimentary service.

highlights.text: Auro brings Michelin-starred dining to Calistoga.
Four Seasons describes the resort as a Forbes Five-Star Hotel.
Vineyard Rooms look directly onto the 4.7-acre organic Cabernet Sauvignon vineyard.
Elusa Winery makes wines from grapes grown on the property.
Spa Talisa is inspired by Calistoga's mineral-rich geothermal springs.

considerations.text: The resort offers on-site valet parking only.
By car, the resort is an hour and a half from San Francisco.
Advance reservations are highly recommended for all restaurant, winery and transportation bookings.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
